limitations: 63 is the scoped local candidate suite, not a new full product regression.
Explicit MemoryFS/bus/manager doubles do not emulate all systemd or Linux credential semantics.
Historical positive diagnostic differs in payload, properties and date; it is not a single-variable native A/B.
Native setup and production delivery remain unverified; the prior SSH grant is exhausted.
No extra effective capability is accepted by relaxed guards; the unchanged guard still requires the exact original masks and identity.

mechanismHypothesis.summary: Upstream v255 maps no-setuid to the command credential-handling flag. Its seccomp credential path can remove non-ambient CAP_SETUID; the candidate avoids that path for the fixed root setup command. This is not proof about the deployed Ubuntu build or the observed event.
